title: Graph symbolic distillation derives an interpretable hydration-property formula
summary: Graph Symbolic Distillation converts graph-model representations into an interpretable symbolic descriptor for hydration properties and evaluates the result against FreeSolv measurements. This is a computational materials-and-chemistry result on the studied dataset; it does not establish a molecular mechanism or performance beyond the evaluated properties.
ai_technology: Graph Symbolic Distillation using graph neural networks and symbolic regression
organization: Department of Physics and Bavarian Center for Battery Technologies, University of Bayreuth

evidence.tested: The method distills graph data into symbolic formulas and evaluates hydration-property predictions against existing FreeSolv measurements.
evidence.unknown: The result is bounded to the reported dataset and properties; no molecular mechanism is established by the formula alone.
evidence.ai_role: Graph neural-network representations are distilled into symbolic descriptors for hydration-property prediction.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
